notablePrerequisites: Bighorner Rancher does not have summoning sickness. You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
